name: GetMHInfoFromPipeSch
comment: Returns one row per pipe connected to a manhole. Arguments: CMH, USMH, DSMH, USIL, DSIL, PipeDia, PipeMat. Each pipe argument is a column of the same length. An inlet is a pipe whose downstream manhole is CMH. An outlet is a pipe whose upstream manhole is CMH. The nine values are CMH, inlet invert, inlet diameter, inlet material, inlet from manhole, outlet invert, outlet diameter, outlet material, and outlet to manhole. A missing side is "-". Extra rows repeat CMH. Omitting CMH returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
